text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
My absolute top-fave junior Umamusume is 
running in the NHK Mile Cup, which I ran 
in last year too, so we all came out to 
cheeeer her on!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Man, what a run. I've seen tons of 
Umamusume in my time, but witnessing the 
birth of a whole new generation like 
this... Huh? Isn't this way too emotional? 
I can't even, send help.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm not just chasing after other Umamusume 
anymore; I'm the one being chased now...! 
I've gotta show the juniors a great run 
too, you know.
